name: Free Sales Forecast Sensitivity Report PowerPoint Template
description: An editable sales forecast sensitivity report for explaining the base case, downside triggers, pipeline evidence and decisions that could change the outlook.
longDescription: This original sales forecast sensitivity report helps a team explain a forecast as a set of testable assumptions. Eight editable widescreen PowerPoint slides cover the reporting context, baseline, evidence, scenario drivers, forecast method, decision cadence, limitations and next action. A warm paper field, offset signal lanes and small decision markers create a distinct visual system from the existing sales dashboards and cohort reports. All figures are illustrative placeholders and must be replaced with verified sales data.
cover: A forecast is a decision map
Show the assumptions, signals and actions that could change the next sales outlook.
